messages:
Simone: kicking off v6-lite-int4 canary now. focus on longform and rerank slices, want conservative gates.

Priya: noted. initial shadow run showed cost drop ~28% but rerank NDCG down ~0.55% and a tiny longform halluc delta +0.9%.

Ran: quick numbers (shadow 8k reqs):
- NDCG@10 (rerank): -0.55% abs
- longform hallucination: +0.9% abs (slice size 1.6k)
- latency p95: +22ms

Jess: deploy-bot: canary started model=v6-lite-int4 weight=5% region=us-east-1

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: model=v6-lite-int4 weight=5% initiated_by=Simone

Simone: propose per-slice gating knobs:
- global_min_samples: 4k
- longform_min_samples: 3k
- rerank_ndcg_threshold: 0.4% abs
- longform_halluc_threshold: 1.0% abs
- latency_margin: 30ms over slo
- hysteresis: 2 windows OR single-window effect >=1.3x threshold
- warmup_ignore: 15m

Priya: longform sample under 3k now, signal noisy. suggest hold at 5% until longform hits min.

Ran: agree. also add sticky-session cohort guard: if pin_rate>60% and cohort regresses -> cohort fallback.

ml-eval-bot: Note: bayes_factor for rerank current window = 4.2 (inconclusive).

Simone: action: pause ramp until longform sample >=3k or rerank bayes_factor>10. if rerank ndcg breach >0.8% at any step -> hard rollback. soft rollback = reduce canary by 50% for 30m + investigate. create incident on any automatic fallback.

Jess: ops will prepare runbook and tag run eval id eval-2026-03-v6lite-1. I'll also add composite alert combining ndcg and halluc metrics.

Ran: lowering next step to 15% if we proceed. tagging this channel for any pages.

Simone: thanks team. will monitor; pager if anything crosses hard thresholds. :eyes:
